| description = The man behind the curtain. Stanos heads the powerful smuggling ring which controls [[Highpass Hold]] in partnership with the boss of Highkeep, [[Carson Mccabe]]. This organization competes with the [[Circle of Unseen Hands]], a human rogue guild based in Qeynos. He is also the father of and rival to [[Renux Herkanor]], and is a central character in the [[Rogue Epic Quest]].

Located inside the hidden cave with all the smugglers. Triggered spawn by saying "I need to see Stanos" to [[Anson McBale]]. Only 50+ Rogues can spawn Stanos.
